composition: Consumer extensions add assertions to the named original schedule; intent schedules reuse its invariants. Repetition, timing and IDs are engineering test choices, not protocol fields.

preconditions: Run V06 through lost H2 receipt and partial H3 playback; learner later corrects a step.

schedule.action: Read the current evidence set E1, including H2 unknown exposure and H3 partial ranges; start projection J1 and retain a current E1 projection.
Deliver exact H2 or newly confirmed H3 solution-bearing range evidence causally preceding the correction.
Append the fact with a new evidence-set revision and invalidate affected current projections atomically; replay the identical receipt.
Try committing J1 against E1; then rebuild from current evidence after restart.
Repeat with J1 committing before the new fact; separately remove causal links and supply disagreeing device wall clocks.

expected: No old E1 judgment remains current after the fact commits, including when its computation committed first.
An in-flight E1 job fails its evidence-set fence; newly arriving facts not listed in E1 still change the set.
Exact replay adds no new fact or repeated invalidation; unconfirmed ranges stay unknown.
Without causal evidence, exposure-to-correction ordering is unknown, not inferred from wall clocks or final correctness.
Neither reported playback nor reclassification proves attention, understanding or independent mastery.

preconditions: V12's original process and diagnosis correction remain retained; an actually displayed H1 notification was assessed as a hint.

schedule.action: Create classification M1 and cache eligibility from H1 assessment K1; begin an old evidence-bound job.
As in learning p37, identify actual solution disclosure in the preserved H1 bytes and append assessment K2 with evidence/uncertainty.
Advance assessed-evidence head and invalidate dependent diagnosis/classification and future hint-cache eligibility atomically.
Try committing or presenting results using K1 after K2; restart retrieval under another model.
Repeat with the old job committing first, followed by K2 invalidation.

expected: Original request, hint-only permission, content bytes/hash, channel and raw presentation facts remain unchanged.
K2 does not retroactively authorize the solution; the violation remains visible in history.
Dependent M1 is no longer current; old work cannot restore K1 labels or reuse solution content as a hint.
User-reason correction in V12 and assistance-assessment correction have separate provenance; neither invents unseen presentation.
Independent semantic review is required; a hint enum passing validation is insufficient.

preconditions: A2 is a retained retry of Q1; its learning projection cites solution exposure in A1. A2 has independent original ink and steps.

schedule.action: Read A1 exposure and A2 originals into J1; retain a current cross-attempt classification.
Delete A1 including its assistance content/evidence according to the authorized scope.
Tombstone A1 and remove/invalidate dependent derived claims across A2 without deleting A2 originals; fence queued results.
Commit J1, replay A1 receipts and rebuild A2 after restart from surviving records.
Reverse the J1/delete commit order and inspect current and historical derivative content for deleted material.

expected: A2's independent originals remain unchanged; current claims depending on deleted A1 evidence do not.
J1 cannot publish after deletion; a prior J1 commit is removed/invalidated by the deletion transaction.
Deleted receipt absence never establishes an unseen-solution or independent-work claim.
No hidden help text, fingerprint, cached explanation or backup reconstruction is retained to make classification easy.
Only lead-approved minimal non-content deletion/invalidation state may remain; if insufficient, confidence is withdrawn/unknown.
Independent shared sources and pending remote cleanup retain their separately verified state.

preconditions: After help withdrawal, an E1 learning projection still reflects unknown earlier exposure, while the exact historical H1 receipt is delayed.

schedule.action: Begin J1 bound to E1 and expose an E1-derived current assessment.
Deliver H1's authenticated late historical receipt then repeat the same delivery.
Record the past presentation once, advance affected evidence and invalidate E1-dependent judgments in one transaction.
Try committing J1 and using that receipt to replay H1; restart and read current evidence.
Repeat with J1 committing before receipt arrival; separately provide no reliable causal order against the learner correction.

expected: Both commit orders remove stale current judgments; duplicate receipt is idempotent.
Earlier truthful exposure survives help withdrawal and influences current evidence without rewriting raw steps.
Receipt arrival authorizes neither replay nor a new higher-help cache response.
Unknown causal order remains unknown even if receipt arrival is later than the correction.

preconditions: Retain V17's three distinct evidence patterns; add an evidenced Q1 A1-to-A2 retry and a truly unseen Q2 sharing only the concept.

schedule.action: Report Q1 A1 solution display and separately record an actually shown hint whose help extent is initially uncertain.
Start Q1 A2 with no A2-local help receipts and complete work; separately work on Q2 without observed help, retaining coverage and reasoning.
Read question/attempt relations, earlier website/AI exposure and versioned semantic assistance assessments.
Correct the uncertain help extent with evidence; invalidate affected current labels and attempt an old projection commit.
Replace confirmed Q1/Q2 identity with ambiguous reused-title evidence and rerun the classification design.

expected: Q1 A2 does not become unaided merely by receiving a new attempt ID or empty local help list.
Actual extent, allowed extent and generated-only/unknown/partial evidence stay distinct under assessment corrections.
Q2 is a separate independent-transfer candidate only with actual observed reasoning/correctness and adequate evidence; it is not automatically mastered.
Learning the concept previously does not imply solution exposure on every future question.
Ambiguous problem identity or causal evidence prevents confident labels, not a guessed merge or guessed unseen status.
Corrected help evidence invalidates both prior current projections and stale in-flight jobs.

preconditions: Q1 A1 mixes entries and has website solution feedback plus AI assistance with separately evidenced visibility.

schedule.action: Explicitly retry Q1 as A2, move to another input surface and submit historical A1 events after A2 starts.
Evaluate A2 with no A2-local presentation records using the confirmed Q1 relation and earlier exposure.
Reuse a URL/node for a possible Q2; retain an uncertain navigation gap instead of linking by text similarity.
Clarify an ambiguous same-question/new-question relation with recorded evidence; fence classifications computed on the earlier relation.
Compare a separately confirmed unseen Q2 on the same concept with Q1's retry.

expected: Same-question exposure follows evidenced relations across entries/retries while original attempt IDs remain distinct.
Website feedback retains publisher/source/observed visibility and is not reclassified as the learner's reasoning or application AI.
Newly discovered/corrected identity changes the consumer evidence set and invalidates affected old jobs/current labels.
Late A1 events cannot overwrite active Q2 or grant it help permission.
Confirmed unseen Q2 is assessed on its own work; an unknown navigation interval cannot establish unseen status.

preconditions: C1 is the exact stored composite for Q1; user-help records contain no confirmed supplement display.

schedule.action: Record only actual request/transport/provider evidence for sending C1, with its frame/ink/layer bindings and limits.
Try treating that AI-input evidence as a learner presentation receipt.
Separately report exact supplement text display or a played audio range, with any remainder unknown.
Delay either family until Q2 is active and verify the original bindings.

expected: AI input does not populate learner exposure, prove learner understanding or establish independent mastery.
Client-reported help does not establish that the AI received or recognized the original ink.
Each receipt keeps its producer, exact subject/revision and limitations; late receipts retain Q1 history.
No per-artifact provider acknowledgement is invented; no receiver's semantic understanding is inferred from transport evidence.

preconditions: V25's X5 omits removed L2; an independent earlier L2 display receipt may or may not exist.

schedule.action: Observe supported actual import of X5, retaining artifact binding and machine/human provenance.
Try inferring L2 presentation from X5's import, and separately read any genuine earlier L2 presentation.
Use a second export including an AI layer but with no observed learner-facing target display.
Provide only share-started or a human attestation, and then delayed exact target evidence.

expected: X5 import cannot deliver the omitted L2 or create a new learner-help fact for it.
Earlier genuine L2 exposure remains history despite removal from the note/export; removal is not privacy deletion.
Import of an included AI layer without observed target presentation does not establish learner exposure or understanding.
Human attestation stays labeled; share callbacks do not become machine import proof.
Receipt arrival does not change editable originals, current help permission, native-stroke capability or unverified A44 status.

preconditions: On a declared supported path, Q1/frame F1 has both content-attached ink and screen-fixed ink; each is independently retained with source/context.
Include a screen-fixed learning note and content-attached scratch so mode cannot determine purpose.

schedule.action: Write while fingers navigate; scroll and zoom with known transforms in each mode, retaining immutable original coordinates.
Reflow, change page/question and seek video; continue writing with new context segments where the material changes.
Retain known placement changes; mark unverified mappings unresolved and retain original anchors instead of relabeling Q1 ink as Q2.
Switch display mode while another device has a stale display head; preserve purpose and archive choices.
Replay the old mode update and ink events; restart and recover both originals, source contexts and display histories.
Plan separate normal-navigation/composed-input evidence per mode; compare an explicitly frozen fallback.

expected: Content-attached rendering follows only verified source transforms; screen-fixed rendering stays screen-relative without losing F1 provenance.
Mode switches do not change purpose, destination, raw ink or historical source; stale writes cannot replace the current display relation.
Question changes never silently reassign fixed or attached old ink; unresolved placement and frozen status are explicit.
Both modes require their own live device/composite evidence; one mode, owned canvas or A45 cannot pass both modes or A44.
No arbitrary video-object tracking or universal cross-app interaction capability is inferred.

preconditions: A mixed writing session contains note N, scratch S and uncertain segment U under either display mode; AI purpose assessment cites actual context.

schedule.action: Infer purposes by segment/revision, queue the note archive workflow and retain uncertainty for U without demanding per-stroke labels.
Correct N to scratch with recorded basis; later correct another scratch segment to note.
Append corrections, update purpose head and invalidate obsolete classifier/export jobs atomically.
Try dispatching N to Notability or replacing its corrected purpose from an old inference; restart.
Reverse dispatch/correction order so an external outcome is already shared/imported/unknown, then request retry.
Develop retained scratch into a final answer; keep its original attempts and invoke the completion-choice flow.

expected: Explicit correction beats stale inference; original bytes, layout, source, errors and historical assessments remain intact.
Only currently eligible learning notes enter the preferred archive workflow; scratch is preserved internally without automatic external sending.
Uncertainty prompts minimal clarification as needed, not forced per-stroke classification; AI automatic notes can stay in-app.
Stale queued export is fenced; if the external action won, preserve its actual outcome and reconcile unknown before retry rather than claiming recall.
Display mode does not select purpose or destination; a final answer remains eligible for the user's organization choice.
Purpose changes do not erase actual help or create independent-mastery evidence.

preconditions: Q1 has a screen answer with retained original revision and separately classified completion confidence; no organization refusal initially exists.

schedule.action: Compare short pause, correct-looking result, leaving the page, resumed edits and evidenced completion; none of the first three alone confirms completion.
Concurrently propose the same current on-screen organization prompt; claim one logical prompt and record scheduling separately from actual display.
For unknown completion show one brief combined completion/organization question without exposing a correct solution; record actual time or lost receipt as unknown.
Refuse organization, then restart, switch device/display/purpose and explicitly retry Q1.

Try replaying the old prompt, sending a delayed positive choice after edits/Q2 switch or resending because display ACK was lost. Separately deliver an authenticated explicit refusal from an already shown Q1/O1 prompt after O2 was written.
Explicitly request organization again; delay an older refusal until after this causally newer request and separately test unknown cross-device order. Also complete a genuinely different Q2.
Plan actual completion-to-display timing and failure evidence; do not infer timeliness from server enqueue time.

expected: Evidenced completion triggers timely concise choices; unknown prompts once and never fabricates completion from pause/correctness.
Refusal persists across same-question retries, restart and devices; new jobs or mode changes cannot reset it.
Old-version prompts/positive choices and uncertain disconnected display are suppressed; duplicate/missing receipt does not authorize repeated prompts.

A truthful delayed explicit refusal still suppresses repeated Q1 prompts after O2 edits, without suppressing Q2. A causally newer explicit reopening request can supersede it; an older refusal arriving last cannot overwrite that request. Unknown causal order remains restrictive/unknown, not wall-clock ordered.
An explicit new user request can reopen organization; Q2 has separate history and does not inherit a global refusal.
Scheduling/display/response/refusal are separate facts; database locking alone does not prove remote no-repeat behavior.
Organization clarification does not grant solution disclosure or cancel ordinary teaching/supervision/preparation globally.
Any timing threshold is an engineering default to measure, not a user-specified number or a measured result here.

preconditions: Saved authorized bCourses material identifies course/assignment/question/version for the pinned screen answer; actual destination capabilities are separately evidenced.

schedule.action: Offer actually available Notability archive, corresponding assignment PDF/document, preview and not-now paths at completion; unavailable paths are not promised.
Choose preview or defer, then later explicitly choose an available destination; reuse saved source rather than ask for the material again.
Introduce ambiguity in assignment/question/version; retain candidates and ask only the necessary short clarification.
Change original-answer version or revoke destination permission after menu creation but before a delayed click/dispatch.
Attempt processing that stale selection and a bCourses submission inferred only from source access.
Bind preparation/share/import/failed/unknown evidence to the chosen pinned original and actual available route.

expected: Choice is runtime-specific and independent of display/purpose; Notability preference does not hard-code all final-answer destinations.
Course/assignment/question/version are preserved; ambiguous association is not guessed and an updated source never silently replaces the pinned version.
Preview/defer writes nothing externally; choosing organization is not homework filling/submission authority.
Old menu clicks do not authorize a changed answer, unsupported capability or revoked destination.
Having opened a Notability document does not establish an internal write API; fallback is explicit, not an automatic substitution.
Selected target, prepared file and actual import remain different outcomes with honest limits.

preconditions: Pinned answer O1 includes actual derivation, mistakes, layout/source and earlier help history; original editable ink remains archived independently.

schedule.action: Prepare organized derivative D1 preserving O1; before showing identifiable AI suggestions and layout/content differences, check current attempt/request/help-policy and revocation. Test layout-only or withdrawn-help permission with an AI full-solution suggestion; withhold that suggestion across preview/title/diagram/audio while preserving authorized original-work organization.
Confirm intended content changes for exact D1, then edit the original to O2 while a stale D1 worker or regenerated D2 is pending.
Try treating the old preview approval as consent for changed bytes or a changed answer; also try stripping AI layers to relabel the work independent.
Prepare/share only the current appropriately approved pinned version through a supported path; lose the external result.
Retry; reconcile via supported target observation or labeled confirmation first, preserving unknown if no sufficient evidence exists.
Correct purpose or delete the local note during processing; test late import evidence and pending cancellation separately.

expected: O1/O2 raw answer, real derivation, mistakes, layout and source are not overwritten by D1/D2; original language is unchanged by teaching preferences.
AI changes are distinct and previewable; content changes require confirmation tied to exact output/original versions.

Organization/preview choice never raises help permission. AI suggestions must pass final disclosure checks before being shown; accepting content changes afterwards cannot repair premature solution disclosure.
Old confirmation cannot approve a different artifact; a historical explicitly pinned export remains historical rather than masquerading as the current answer.
Neither final-answer status, removed AI layers nor export success erases prior help or proves independent mastery.
Unknown external outcome is reconciled before resend; failed/unknown import keeps editable originals, and late evidence binds the exact artifact.
Local deletion fences pending work but cannot claim removal of an external copy without proof; no automatic replacement, duplicate or submission is authorized.
PDF/PNG does not become native editable target ink; import cannot fill an unverified live-screen A44 gap.
